newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Rosenbauer poised for big Far East order.
newsitem.headline: Rosenbauer poised for big Far East order.

text.p: Austria's Rosenbauer International AG, a leading manufacturer of fire engines, said on Wednesday it was on the verge of securing a large order in the Far East.
Chief executive Julian Wagner told journalists a decision could be expected within the next few days, but declined to give exact details as the negotiations were in their final stage.
"It's a very, very substantial order," said Wagner. Last year's order from Indonesia worth 238 million schillings "was big, but not very big."
